title: Toolchain profile: the thing under test in one arm
description: A profile describes what the planner gets: MCP servers, extra system prompt files and a static context bundle. Generation settings live in the run, so arms cannot differ in model configuration. Files store environment variable names, never secrets.

revision.description: Release, commit or build of the tooling under test. The harness records it; it cannot verify a remote deployment.

knowledge_revision.description: Frozen revision of the documentation or annotations the tooling serves. Arms must match unless --allow-knowledge-change.

url_env.description: Environment variable holding the MCP endpoint URL.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding a bearer token. Optional.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the profile file unless absolute.

env_names.description: Environment variables forwarded to the server process by name.

system_prompt_files.description: Text or Markdown files appended to the planner's system prompt, relative to the profile file. Use for rules files or skills.

root.description: Directory the globs are resolved against, relative to the profile file. Defaults to the profile's directory.

include.description: Glob patterns of files pasted verbatim into the system prompt (the docs-dump baseline).

max_chars.description: Hard cap on bundled characters. Files are added in sorted order until the cap is reached; the cut point is recorded in the manifest.

toolAllowList.description: Tools exposed to the planner. Only connect what the experiment is about.
